name: better-writing
description: Faithful English and Russian prose with reusable project context, Source Packs, and audited claims.

interface.longDescription: Draft, revise, and synthesise polished prose from drafts, PDFs, scans, OCR, and Source Packs while preserving facts, provenance, project terminology, uncertainty, locale, and writer voice, with deterministic project-profile and claim-ledger checks.
